As a developer following daily model deployments, the focus in engineering is rapidly moving toward lower API overhead and specialized agent workflows.

Here are the top developments in AI today:

⚡ OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast computer-use and vision model priced at $1 and $5 per million tokens. It matches GPT-6 Astra on medium-effort Agents' Last Exam scores while reducing per-task costs from $4.82 to $0.29.

🛠️ Greptile is moving bug detection beyond standard code review by using GPT-6 Astra for workflow testing, Daybreak for security strengthening, and Codex to decrease developer rework.

🔬 OpenAI reported three major discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics, introducing a working framework with external academic experts called shepherds to guide research output.

🌙 Kimi launched a new AI model designed to challenge leading frontier systems including GPT-6 and Claude.

🎓 Google highlighted practical user trends by featuring 15 college students sharing their favorite Gemini workflow capabilities.

For engineers building automated agent loops, dropping per-task execution costs by over 90 percent is a significant shift for production scaling.
